name: Isomori Shouma
source:
"If you have any love troubles, you can come to me for advice, okay?"

The vice-president of the literature club and a fan of romance. He has a bright and lively personality.

Though he occasionally fails to read the room, he makes up for it with his natural charm. He's one of the few people who casually strikes up conversations with the aloof Reiji.

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara06.html]official website[/url]]
